body: Vimal Kejriwal (MD & CEO) on 2025-02-04 (Q3FY25 concall transcript): "we could end up anywhere between 12% to 14%" Metric: Consolidated revenue growth YoY. Target: +12-14% (needs Q4 +22-23%). Deadline: 2025-03-31. Specificity: range; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-21: partly. Evidence: FY25 revenue INR 21,847 cr vs 19,914 cr = +9.7% (screener; company '10%'). Ratio 9.7/12 = 0.81. Q4 grew +11%, not the 22-23% needed. Explanation given: water-project slowdown (delayed state payments), labour shortage, T&D supply-chain bottlenecks (Q4FY25 opening remarks)
